contributions.title: Bug report: BanyanDB MCP server config
contributions.summary: Found and reported that BanyanDB's MCP server ignored .env values and silently accepted malformed settings (e.g. 1MiB read as 1, 60s as 60, an invalid TRANSPORT falling back to stdio), with a reproduction and fix ideas. Another contributor opened the fix, apache/skywalking-banyandb#1460, which credits this report.
contributions.note: Reported 4 Nov 2026 · fix in banyandb#1460 (another contributor)

contributions.title: fix(ci): enable gocyclo, gocognit and cyclop with current-max thresholds
contributions.summary: Turns on three complexity linters (gocyclo, gocognit, cyclop) for issue #5486, with thresholds set at today's maximum so nothing breaks and new code can't get worse.

contributions.title: feat(trait/keda): add Apache Pulsar scaler mapping
contributions.summary: Adds an Apache Pulsar autoscaler to Camel K's KEDA trait (issue #6932): the scaler mapping, unit tests, an end-to-end test in the KEDA workflow and docs.

contributions.title: fix(mcp): accept the Bearer auth scheme case-insensitively
contributions.summary: BanyanDB's MCP HTTP server rejected `bearer` tokens with 401 because it matched the auth scheme case-sensitively. The fix accepts any case, as the HTTP spec requires, with 4 new tests. I found it while reading the code and filed apache/skywalking#14199 with the fix ready; the issue is assigned to me and both are on the BanyanDB 0.12.0 milestone.
contributions.note: Opened 5 Nov 2026 · issue #14199 assigned to me · milestone 0.12.0

contributions.title: kgateway_build_info Prometheus metric
contributions.summary: Added a build-info metric (version, revision, Go version, OS/arch) so operators can see which build every pod runs. The maintainer extended it into a reusable metrics.NewInfo helper; issue #13457 closed as completed. Shipped in kgateway v2.5.0-beta.2.

contributions.title: RBAC metadata test for every capability
contributions.summary: Checks that every tool, prompt, resource and resource template across all 12 toolsets declares valid RBAC metadata, using a real cluster inspector. All 14 CI checks green on the first run, approved on the first review (closes #1435).

contributions.title: Fix flaky HTTP server startup in tests
contributions.summary: Replaced a ~0.5 s retry loop with a 5 s readiness poll and made test setup clean up before failing, fixing intermittent failures on the slow macOS CI runner. Two review rounds (closes #1445).

contributions.title: Ginkgo unit tests for executor metrics
contributions.summary: 20 specs covering every pod-phase transition, label sanitising and registration error paths: 100% of sparkpod_metrics.go, plus a fix for a wrong failure-count log message. Requested by a maintainer under #3202; review changes done.
contributions.note: Opened 18 Oct · LGTM 20 Oct · waiting for /approve

contributions.title: Workload scaler: onlyReadyPods option
contributions.summary: New onlyReadyPods setting for the Kubernetes workload scaler: counts only pods that are Running and Ready (not terminating), so scaling ignores pods that can't serve yet. Design agreed with a maintainer on #4394; labelled kind/feature.

contributions.title: Move IsPodReady to pkg/util
contributions.summary: Follow-up to #8317, suggested by a maintainer: one shared IsPodReady helper in pkg/util (with tests) used by both the workload scaler and fallback, replacing two copies.

contributions.title: Docs for the onlyReadyPods parameter
contributions.summary: Documentation for the new onlyReadyPods option of the Kubernetes workload scaler, the companion to KEDA #8317.

contributions.title: MCP trace topology: cycles and reused span IDs
contributions.summary: Found and reported (#9991) a bug in Jaeger's MCP get_trace_topology tool: traces with reused span IDs looped and parent cycles silently dropped spans. The fix links spans by position, expands each ID once and keeps output deterministic; 6 tests cover self-parents, two cycles, shared IDs and the depth limit.

contributions.title: statPrefix for local rate limits
contributions.summary: Adds rateLimit.local.statPrefix to the traffic policy, with route template tokens, so local rate-limit stats can be told apart per route (#14925). Unit and translator tests, including strict mode; labelled kind/feature.

contributions.title: Fix main not building (Kiali status probe)
contributions.summary: Found that main stopped compiling after two PRs merged out of order, and fixed it. The maintainer merged his own fix (#1526) with the same code change plus a test, so this one was closed as superseded.

contributions.title: Root-caused a “flaky” test
contributions.summary: Showed that a reported flaky failure on another contributor's PR was a real merge-order bug, reproduced it and suggested the fix. The author confirmed it, applied the fix and closed the issue as root-caused.

contributions.title: Migrate the API reference docs generator
contributions.summary: Evaluated crd-ref-docs against genref with sample output, line counts and field-accuracy checks (genref marked some optional fields as required), and recommended crd-ref-docs for the maintainer's decision.

contributions.title: Metrics audit
contributions.summary: Posted an inventory of findings for the maintainer's metrics audit and offered a cleanup PR for him to pick.
